items.title: Turning Data Into Stories People Remember
items.location: Online
items.summary: Data is powerful, but on its own it rarely inspires action. In this session, we’ll take a real dataset of baby names from the U.S. Census Bureau and turn it into a story that grabs attention. You’ll learn how to find the most interesting insights, visualize them in ways that make sense, and weave them into a narrative that resonates with any audience. Whether your story feels like a history, a tragedy, or a thriller, you’ll leave knowing how to make your data speak in a way that people remember. **Important Details** This event will be ONLINE using Teams. not in person!
